PLAN: Finish the validated recovery trends. Final solve: extend only TTTB boil-up from 11 to 13, retaining B dp 0.35. R1014 confirms boil-up 12 remains profitable (2.865); 15 alone likely still gains revenue but its companion B change was unfavorable.
B dp 0.35 is optimal among tested; 0.40 destroys C6 blend, and 0.36 with reflux 5.1 costs more than it gains. TTTB recovery rises from 226 mol/s at 11 to 230 at 12 and 241 at 15. Use 13 for final incremental recovery without excessive duty. Heavy BB and tiny light wastes are uneconomic.
